texts.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的几大帝国在中心集权方面获得重大进展，行政力量集中在少数有实力的领袖手中。低效的狂躁大众统治正在渐渐淡出他们的社会。
texts.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have made great strides in centralizing their various planetary governments, with political power redirected towards a few, capable leaders. The inefficiencies of mob rule are slowly being weeded out of their society.

label.zh: 他们以后会感激我们的。
label.en: They will thank us one day.

texts.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
我们小心翼翼地将[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]推向了更民主的思想，而在我们到达之前，他们的世界还是原始的精英独裁型统治盛行。他们渐渐意识到了个人价值的重要性。
texts.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
We have carefully nudged the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] towards more democratic ideals, in place of the primitive despotism that was prevalent on their world before we arrived. They are beginning to appreciate the value of the individual.

label.zh: 他们以后会感激我们的。
label.en: They will thank us one day.

texts.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]越来越保守，对异族抱有越来越大的警惕。
texts.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun turning inwards, becoming more and more wary of those they regard as strangers.

label.zh: 他们以后会感激我们的。
label.en: They will thank us one day.

texts.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]渐渐开放，变得越来越容易能接受与他们文化迥然不同，曾被视为异族的外星人。
texts.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are starting to open up, becoming more and more accepting and curious about all the things their people out of ignorance once considered alien and strange to their culture.

label.zh: 他们以后会感激我们的。
label.en: They will thank us one day.

texts.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
我们发现[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的各帝国出现了发展军团为主社会的趋势。他们的军团变得更加训练有素。
texts.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
We are seeing a definite movement towards a more militaristic society by the various [From.GetSpeciesAdj] governments. Their standing military forces, such as they are, have become more professional in nature.

label.zh: 他们以后会感激我们的。
label.en: They will thank us one day.

texts.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
[From.Capital.GetName]上的多数[From.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国正在改掉他们好战的习性。[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]上似乎迎来了一个新的和平时代。
texts.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
Most of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] realms on [From.Capital.GetName] are abandoning their warlike ways. It looks like the beginning of a new era of peace on the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat].

label.zh: 他们以后会感激我们的。
label.en: They will thank us one day.

texts.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
我们让[From.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]领悟了他们之前所不理解的精神世界。他们终于有了信仰，他们的社会也因此更加充实。
texts.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
We have opened the minds of the [From.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to a spiritual realm they never knew was there. They finally have something to believe in, and their society is all the richer for it.

label.zh: 他们以后会感激我们的。
label.en: They will thank us one day.

texts.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
破除荼毒[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]社会的迷茫和原始信仰的行动大获成功。他们开始意识到了科学与理性的价值。
texts.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
We have made great strides in ridding the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] of the superstitions and primitive beliefs that plagued their society. They are beginning to see the value of science and rationality.

label.zh: 他们以后会感激我们的。
label.en: They will thank us one day.
